old_caption: The video opens with two figures standing side by side on a stage-like structure, both dressed in white lab coats adorned with various logos and text. They wear wide-brimmed hats, one beige and the other white, adding to their distinctive appearance. The backdrop features a clear blue sky and distant hills, suggesting an outdoor setting. A large, transparent dome-like structure surrounds them, supported by metal scaffolding. An explosion occurs behind the figures, sending a massive wave of white powder and debris flying outward. The figures remain stationary throughout the blast, seemingly unaffected by the force. The debris swirls around the figures, creating a chaotic yet visually striking scene. The video concludes with the dust settling, leaving the figures still standing amidst the aftermath of the explosion.
original_wisa_caption: The video opens with two figures standing side by side on a stage-like structure, both dressed in white lab coats adorned with various logos and text. They wear wide-brimmed hats, one beige and the other white, adding to their distinctive appearance. The backdrop features a clear blue sky and distant hills, suggesting an outdoor setting. A large, transparent dome-like structure surrounds them, supported by metal scaffolding. As the scene progresses, a dramatic explosion occurs behind the figures, sending a massive wave of white powder and debris flying outward. The figures remain stationary throughout the blast, seemingly unaffected by the force. The camera captures the explosion from multiple angles, emphasizing the scale and intensity of the event. The debris swirls around the figures, creating a chaotic yet visually striking scene. The video concludes with the dust settling, leaving the figures still standing amidst the aftermath of the explosion.
caption: Two upright mannequins with foil-wrapped faces, wide-brimmed hats and white lab coats stand side by side on a circular platform, framed by silver truss towers against a clear blue sky, dry desert hills and a white fabric barrier. A tall red-and-grey panel with faint scale numbers sits behind them. The view slowly enlarges as the truss legs drift toward the frame edges and the panel grows more visible. A bright yellow-orange flash flares at the right figure's shoulder while a white burst opens at the left figure's head. A dense white cloud then erupts and expands, engulfing both forms. The lab coats shred, and torn white fabric strips are thrown outward, a long sleeve piece flying to the right. The hats are pushed upward, perched atop the billowing cloud before becoming partly obscured. The cloud keeps churning and spreading, filling most of the frame while the bodies vanish behind it. The slow enlargement continues through the burst, so the white mass occupies more of the view.

endpoints are normal, not physical errors. Do not add unseen causes, onset, stopping or outcomes.
An internal editing cut is not evidence of physical motion connecting the views.

Check identification before physical interpretation: a reflection is not a separate actor;
a powder/smoke/liquid outline or shadow is not automatically the boundary of a solid object;
an apparent change caused by occlusion/viewpoint is not automatically material deformation.
Do not claim contact, bending, compression, melting, disintegration or structural recovery unless
the appropriate material/surface itself provides visible evidence. Do not infer a force or earlier
collision just because the visible configuration would be compatible with it.
Compare several frames before asserting translation, rotation, direction, unchanged position or
camera tracking. A single visible texture/seam does not prove spin. Avoid unnecessary absolute
claims of stillness, no motion, no camera motion or 'exactly' synchronized changes.
Remove invented scene details and explanations, but keep clearly visible ongoing motion and
processes. Avoid deleting the real process merely because its cause lies outside the cropped window.

Retain the WISA English narrative style, detail density and paragraph structure. Aim for the
provided original word count within 85%-115%, using genuinely visible details and process.
Do not add repetition, watermark/logo descriptions or atmospheric filler to reach a word count.

'this mid-segment', 'the excerpt', 'the frame', 'these images', 'observed evidence' in the caption.
This is a direct video description, not an analysis note. No mandatory beginning/end formula.
Complete every sentence. If accuracy requires a substantial length difference, explain it outside
the caption; do not fill missing context by imagination. Optional synonym edits are not needed.
